note: 'a size larger' is held as dependents of the nominal 'caps', but the words say to go for 'marker spacing wider'-style change, so 'a size larger' should not be part of the description of the caps
'ahve the boy ... stay' is a command, but 'ahve' is held in discourse and 'stay' is written as a declarative clause with 'the boy' as subject
'face left' after the colon is a command, but 'face' is held as the head of a nominal tied to 'the dog', so the command is lost
'sidee' is the verb of the command, but it is held as the head of a nominal, so no clause has it as verb and the command is lost

'wider' is held as a dependent of 'spacing', but the words say 'go for marker spacing wider', so 'wider' says how the spacing should become, and the coordination 'and' also joins 'go' with 'have' across 'while you're at it'
the verb 'est' of 'est the Shell block into the upper right corner' is held as a modifier of the 'keep' clause, so that command has no clause with it as verb
'this week' is held as a complement of 'make', but the words only set the time of 'make the line medium width as well', so the verb does not act on 'this week'
the coordination 'then' joins 'the entire scene' and 'mind' as conjuncts, but the words only place them after 'dress the scene up as first light all the way through'
'tree' is held as a modifier of 'make' while 'Proposal' is the complement, but 'Proposal tree' is one name, so the words of one nominal are split between wires
'Let us' is a command, but 'Let' is written as the verb of an interrogative clause and 'us' is held as a complement of 'show'
'blocks' is a noun in the list 'topic solar energy and title Quarterly plan and blocks one paragraph', but it is written as the verb of a declarative clause with 'one paragraph' as complement
'label' is the verb of the command 'please label number n4', but it is held as a dependent of 'number', so the command is lost
'flip the x axis over' is a command after 'while you're at it', but it is written as an interrogative clause
'not' in 'not right' is a negation word, but it is held in discourse, so the negation of 'right' is lost
'nothing else of the house' and 'everything else untouched' are merged into one nominal with head 'nothing', but the words give two separate things
in 'scatter plot of for each region scatter', the linking word 'of' is held as a modifier of the fragment instead of marking what the plot is of
'to' in 'characters 10 to 15' is a linking word, but it is held as a dependent of '15'
'the way the drawing looks so far' is held as a complement of 'leave', but the words only compare the leaving to 'the way the drawing looks so far', so the verb does not act on it
'I need the revenue trend legible' is a statement, but it is written as an interrogative clause
'smaler' in 'have the font smaler' is the adjective the font should become, but it is written as the verb of a nonfinite clause
'clear' in 'next clear the top two of the five green blocks' is the verb of that command, but it is held as a modifier of the fragment, so no clause has it as verb

the coordination 'then' joins 'keep the rest as it is' and 'a small dog down at the bottom' with the two 'shift' commands, but in the words 'then' only stands before the second 'shift the BMW block left'
'halve' is the verb of the command, but it is held as a dependent of 'size' in a fragment, so no clause has it as verb and the command is lost
'for' in '15 for 1 star' is a linking word, but it is held as a dependent of 'star'
'change' is the verb of the command, but it is held as a dependent of 'Review' in a fragment, so no clause has it as verb
'then' in 'and then the boy in the purple jacket' is a word of order, but it is held as a dependent of 'boy'
'rotate' is the verb of the command, but it is held as the head of a nominal and 'dwn' is written as the verb though it is no verb
'hollow' in 'the inheritance arrows hollow' is the adjective the arrows should be, but it is written as the verb of a declarative clause
'leave the path clear' is a command after 'and', but it is written as a declarative clause
'then' in 'then a parallel chart' is a word of order, but it is held as a dependent of 'chart'
'make the bars blue' is a command at the end, but it is written as a declarative clause with 'the top six regions' as subject
'I'd like the numbers back' is a statement, but it is written as an interrogative clause
'not' in 'but not left to right' is a negation word, but it is held as a modifier of the fragment, so the negation is lost
'rides', 'repairs' and 'spares' name the wedges, but each is written as the verb of a declarative clause with a percentage as complement
'left' in 'slide block 15 left to block 14' is a direction, but it is written as the verb of a nonfinite clause
'nobody argued with the data' is a statement written as an interrogative, and 'borders' in 'the marker borders thicker' is a noun written as the verb of a declarative clause
'top five regions only' is a part with no verb, but 'top' is written as the verb of an imperative clause
the coordination 'plus' joins 'show the percentages' with 'I showed' across 'make the legend smaller', which the words do not relate
'upright' and 'again' are held as dependents of 'z axis', but the words say 'z axis upright again', how the axis should be
'150 wide and 120 high' is merged into one nominal with head '150', but the words give two measures, '150 wide' and '120 high'
the second 'guide' in 'guide block 10 further left' is held as a dependent of 'block', so that command has no clause with it as verb
'coloured' and 'labelled' are tied to 'size', but the words say 'draw a house ... coloured red, labelled Home', so the house is the thing coloured and labelled
'centre' is the verb of the command 'centre Bin just below e2', but it is held as the head of the nominal 'that centre'
'smaller' in 'one step smaller' is the graded word, but it is the head of a nominal tied by 'to'
'level' is held as a complement nominal of 'bring', but in 'bring the man in the green shirt level with' it says how the man should be, not a thing brought
